correctness.rationale: Exact root-coordinate definitions give the finite sign matrices S,T,B, whose five identities are checked entrywise in the embedded standalone SymPy checker. Together with the dimension-four addition theorem these imply a complete symbolic diagonalization: \(n(n-2\varepsilon)\) with multiplicity 16 and \(n(n+4\varepsilon\pm6\eta)\) each with multiplicity 4. Exact values for n=2,4,6,8,10 and positivity for n≥12 prove ranks for all odd degrees; eps=eta=0 iff 12 divides n gives complete orthogonality criterion. Kernel pseudoinverse proof supplies interpolation and norms. Direct exact Gram calculations and 21-degree checks corroborate but are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 24 natural F4 root lines give a complete, nontrivial harmonic sampling identifiability problem. Its first surjective degree is 7, degree 9 has a four-dimensional obstruction, all subsequent odd degrees regain surjectivity, and every 12th odd degree gives exactly orthogonal zonal samples. The complete spectrum and minimum-energy data reconstruction make these finite and infinite phenomena mathematically usable; they are not a routine consequence of the known 7-design moments.
